plain: A researcher named Steven Greer, on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, mentions the CIA's remote viewing program, an effort by the US spy agency to use people who claimed they could see distant places with their minds. He calls it the cheap end of things and links it to a man named Bob Monroe, suggesting there were far more advanced mind-related projects beyond it.
